hook: Your job is to design the most addictive slot machine in history. Here is how you do it.
full_script: Your job is to design the most addictive slot machine in history. Here is how you do it. First, when a player loses, make sure it is a near miss. Studies show the human brain reacts to near misses similarly to actual wins. It feels frustrating, but it forces us to keep pulling. Second, disguise losses as wins. If they bet a dollar and hit point five, they didn't lose fifty cents. They won fifty cents. Celebrate it with bright lights, sounds, and animations. Lastly, make it fast. This is not roulette where you wait between spins. Pack in as many spins per minute as possible until they enter a betting-induced trance. Congrats. You just designed the most profitable casino game in human history.
